content.what_it_is: Tiny MATLAB helper (nesting benchmark, outer grid A) that generates a station.txt of 42 gauge grid-indices forming an L-shaped nesting boundary: rows 1-21 fix i=80 with j=81..101 (west leg), rows 22-42 fix j=80 with i=81..101 (south leg) (L1-5). Writes two 5-wide integer columns per line via fprintf on the transposed array (L6-8). Commented alternative save -ASCII (L10). These stations supply the boundary time series for the nested grid-B run.

equations.ref: west leg j-range (i=80 fixed L2); south leg i-range L4 with j=80 L5

unresolved: The corner point (80,80) is not included and the two legs share the corner region only via (80,81..101) and (81..101,80); whether FUNWAVE's nesting reader expects a corner station is external to this file.
Variable named 'west' although it holds both a west and a south leg; the index ranges 80..101 are grid-A specific and depend on the grid-B placement defined elsewhere.
